description: 12 vulnerabilities CISA added to KEV in week 46 of 2026, with EPSS scores, public exploits, ransomware use and due dates.
long:
CISA KEV weekly digest, Nov 9–15, 2026: 12 newly confirmed exploited vulnerabilities.

Fix first:
• CVE-2026-123158 — OpenBSD OpenSSH, EPSS 19%
• CVE-2026-116606 — Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG), EPSS 11%
• CVE-2026-111560 — Barracuda Networks Multiple Products, EPSS 9%
• CVE-2026-116779 — SignalWire FreeSwitch, EPSS 2%
• CVE-2026-123039 — Check Point Multiple Products, EPSS 2%
…and 7 more.
